_doc: (#2902 step 2b review) The upper edge of the shared value domain: every count is clamped to 2^53 (the largest integer both a u64 sum and a JS number hold exactly), whether it arrives as an integer literal, an exponent, or a value past f64's integer range. Kept in its own fixture so the other goldens' sums stay below the edge and exactly representable on both sides.
